3. `WeChatAgent` 的 `dshAccess` 是否加了工具名。"},{"id":"p68s1","text":"**Q：报 schema `type: null`？**"},{"id":"p69s1","text":"本仓库的 `lib/index.js` 已使用完整 JSON Schema（`type: "object"` + `required`），不会再走简化参数表。"},{"id":"p70s1","text":"**Q：`/SendVoiceMsg` 返回 409？**"},{"id":"p71s1","text":"通常是微信没登录、账号不唯一，或 `nativeVoiceSend` 不为 true。"},{"id":"p72s1","text":"**Q：返回“当前微信进程没有 /SendVoiceMsg 路由”？**"},{"id":"p73s1","text":"说明加载的还是原版 hook：确认替换后重启了微信，并且 `health.nativeVoiceSend` 为 `true`。"},{"id":"p74s1","text":"**Q：WeChatAgent 启动时报 `Native build hash/version mismatch`？**"},{"id":"p75s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
